node.statement: Case V_n is nonzero: choose Z_0!=0 in V_n. Then R_n is nonempty, every member ||T_n(Z)||/||Z|| is a finite nonnegative real, and R_n is bounded below by 0. Consequently a_n=inf R_n exists as a finite real: it is at least 0 and at most the finite ratio belonging to Z_0.
